cast.name: Skull Kid
cast.note: a lonely imp from the Lost Woods, riding a stolen mask and a stolen moon

cast.name: Majora
cast.note: older than the carnival, angrier than the moon; it ends what it touches, and it is what it is

cast.name: Tatl
cast.note: the sharp one — she scolds, she scouts, she stays. Her brother fell to the curse; her loyalty did not.

cast.name: Tael
cast.note: the quiet one, taken with the Skull Kid into the mask's shadow

cast.name: The Happy Mask Salesman
cast.note: he sells masks, and he buys them; his smile is a transaction. Steal from him and the smile goes elsewhere.

cast.name: The Four Giants
cast.note: the swamp, the mountain, the sea, and the valley — four giants who swore to protect the land, and who answer only to the song that summons them

cast.name: Anju
cast.note: waiting at the inn for Kafei, through every third day, on every cycle

cast.name: Kafei
cast.note: turned young and hunted by his own theft; the only man who married at the end of the world

cast.name: Cremia
cast.note: she guards the milk, her little sister, and the walls against the moon

cast.name: Romani
cast.note: she saw the sky grow a face, and she taught the hero how to ride for a shooting star

cast.name: The Moon Child
cast.note: inside the falling moon, a field, a slide, and a mask that looks like a child wearing a god

termina_truth: Termina is a parallel land — 'a world wrapped in the story of a different hero.' Every soul in it lives the same three days until the ocarina unmakes them and remakes them kinder.
